inclusion_rules: tracked sim/ and test/ source files with extensions .jl/.r/.py/.sh, excluding fixtures and the current Arc1 manifest/tests
tracked sim/ and test/ seed/manifest files with extensions .jl/.r/.py/.sh/.md/.txt/.csv/.tsv/.json/.yaml/.yml
tracked docs/dev-log .md/.txt files and seed/manifest files; receipt/result/output/check-log.d/log/jsonl paths excluded unless named as a seed manifest
only integer literals on lines containing seed, seeds, rng, or MersenneTwister are extracted
limitations: code literals in compound expressions may be conservatively included
this audit establishes no complete historical seed inventory
historical_seed_audit.scope: tracked sim/ and test/ source plus tracked docs/dev-log Markdown/text; only seed-context integer literals

boundary.gate: G5 descriptive exact-zero diagnostics; no nominal coverage threshold

flag_mapping.near_tie: recompute from frozen rank scores and 1e-6 tie tolerance

fa_record_layout.observation_order: record-major; y=vec(Y'); V=B⊗G+I⊗R; Xfull=X⊗I4; rotate U'⊗I4

data_generating_process.residual: independent per record; FA records use multivariate covariance R

execution.seed_type: UInt64, passed without truncation or modulo reduction
execution.seed_version_rule: record exact Julia VERSION at run admission; require 1.10.0

existing_start_construction.K0: g0=max(diag(Gbase),2*uniqueness_floor); transformed g0 plus Cholesky Rbase
existing_start_construction.K1_start_1: structured FA rank-1 parameters from Gbase plus Cholesky Rbase

expanded_reference.K1_sign_order: lexicographic product order, separate from ordinary engine mask order
expanded_reference.status: best found, never claim global optimum
expanded_reference.top_finite_solutions_scope: per rank, independently for K0 and K1

invalid_trials.exhaustion: failed start; restore objective/gradient caches and scratch coordinates; failure step is zero
invalid_trials.policy: guard callbacks and restart Hager-Zhang from the same iterate/direction with a halved offending step bound

fa_optimizer.objective: exact spectral REML with analytic gradient

ordinary.K1_starts: existing two starts plus 16 deterministic K0-derived starts
ordinary.derived_start_order: amplitude-major a=(0.1,0.7), then mask=0:7; mask bit 0 flips trait 2

fa_optimizer.policy: arc1_v1 opt-in; omitted policy preserves legacy path

G2.confirmation: eligibility lower bound in all nine cells plus references and ordinary-K1 witness
G2.pilot: 29/30 numerical eligibility in all nine cells plus required references

G3.confirmation: G2 confirmation plus null K1 upper bounds for each N and strong N=320 lower bound
G3.pilot: G2 pilot plus null K1 at most 6/30 for each N and strong N=320 at least 24/30

gate_output_semantics.G5_exact_zero_diagnostics: two 200-attempt boundary cells are required for confirmation and reported descriptively only
gate_output_semantics.confirmation_scientific_result: separate PASS or FAIL from pilot qualification
gate_output_semantics.failure_denominator: all allocated attempts; never replace failures
gate_output_semantics.pilot_qualification: PASS or HOLD; a pass never admits confirmation

scientific_contract.global_failure_rule: failed pilot holds confirmation; failed confirmation gate remains unmet

bootstrap_usability.outer_fit_failure: record refusal stage and status; no inner attempts

interval_contract.fa_bootstrap: candidate percentile; rerun entire selector in every inner sample; fixed B
interval_contract.failure_policy: retain failed attempts; no replacement; failed pilot holds confirmation
interval_contract.repeatability_method: profile likelihood ratio with explicit zero-component reductions

certified_zero_face_resolution.scope: matching competitive positive lower-bound approximations only

fixed_ratio_target_grid.final_certificate: actual final bracket width <= 1e-7 and raw likelihood spread across endpoints/returned maximum <= 1e-8

continuation.objective_and_gradient: unchanged profile objective and analytic gradient
continuation.start: original candidate's own terminal value for the remaining coordinate

terminal_and_physical_zero_certificate.score_scale: active full or correctly tagged fixed-Ve centered scale

raw_variance_target_search.upper_tail_extension: double until four successive outside-cutoff points with decreasing profile likelihood

profile_search.scale_reference: s0=OLS residual sum of squares / residual df
profile_search.search_claim_limit: finite_grid_resolved describes declared search only; narrower unsampled components are not ruled out
profile_search.unresolved_evaluation: do not interpolate across; retain disconnected components, domain, gaps, refinement history, brackets, tail evidence, and nuisance statuses

rank_selection_gate.allocation: 30 development + 30 pilot + 400 confirmation per each of 9 cells

repeatability_profiles.method: exact REML; analytic scale where available

seed.bootstrap_seed_hash: SHA-256 over ordered ASCII decimal UInt64 seeds, one newline per inner index
seed.hash: SHA-256 UTF-8 pipe-joined fields; UInt64 from first 16 lowercase hex digits
seed.indices: outer and inner 1-based; inner=0 denotes outer-data generation

scope_note: Seed allocation only. No data, truth starts, fits, or outcomes are present.
seed_rule: first 16 hex digits of SHA-256(UTF-8(pipe-joined canonical fields)); UInt64
